message.content:
Build RENEWAL BILLING for the new products (business email + block-storage volumes) at /opt/nxeon. This is a production-critical revenue gap: today only the first period is charged at order time and nothing ever renews. Other agents work elsewhere — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
Next.js 15 + Prisma. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`. Money = integer cents on `User.balanceCents`. Charge pattern (mirror `worker/billing.ts`, READ it — it is NOT yours to edit):
```ts
await db.$transaction([
  db.user.update({ where:{ id }, data:{ balanceCents: { decrement: cents } } }),
  db.walletTransaction.create({ data:{ userId:id, amountCents: -cents, description } }),
  db.<model>.update({ where:{ id }, data:{ expiresAt: newExpiry } }),
  db.auditLog.create({ data:{ userId:id, action:"billing.renewed", detail } }),
]);
```
Models: `EmailSubscription{ userId, domainName, emailPlanId, emailPlan(EmailPlan{priceCents,termMonths}), status("ACTIVE"|"SUSPENDED"|"CANCELLED"), autoRenew, expiresAt }`; `Volume{ userId, serverId, name, sizeGB, priceCents, status("PENDING"|"ATTACHED"|"DETACHED"|"DELETING"), expiresAt }`. Helpers: `import { addMonths } from "@/lib/billing-terms"`. Notifications: `db.notification.create({ data:{ userId, title, body?, href? } })`. Grace/terminate windows: read `worker/billing.ts` for the existing `GRACE_DAYS` style constants and mirror the same policy (warn → grace → suspend).

## TASK
Create `worker/product-renewals.ts` exporting `productRenewalSweep(): Promise<void>` (the orchestrator wires it into the worker loop):
1. **Email subscriptions** — find ACTIVE subs with `expiresAt < now`. If `autoRenew` and balance covers `emailPlan.priceCents`: charge, extend `expiresAt` by `emailPlan.termMonths`, audit, notify. If not: warn the user, then after the grace window set `status="SUSPENDED"` (do NOT delete mailboxes) and notify. Also send an upcoming-renewal warning for subs expiring within ~3 days with insufficient balance (dedupe notifications like billing.ts does).
2. **Volumes** — same shape for `Volume` (monthly `priceCents`). On non-payment past grace: mark the volume `DETACHED` and enqueue a `VOLUME_DETACH` job if it's currently ATTACHED (never destroy customer data automatically — detach only, and notify clearly that data is retained but the volume will be removed if unpaid; do NOT auto-delete).
3. Make every step defensive (individually try/caught) so one bad row never aborts the sweep, and idempotent (re-running must not double-charge — key off `expiresAt` advancing).
Also create `lib/product-billing.ts` (plain module) with any shared pricing/period helpers you need, so the logic is unit-testable.

## OWNED FILES (create ONLY these)
`worker/product-renewals.ts`, `lib/product-billing.ts`.

## HARD RULES
Never touch schema/next.config/layouts/Shell/lib(auth/db/rbac/wallet/billing-terms=read-only)/worker/index.ts/worker/billing.ts/lib/actions*/app/**/ROADMAP/docs or other files. No build/prisma/generate/restart/commit. No new deps.

## REPORT
Files created; exact renewal/grace/suspend policy for each product; how you guarantee no double-charge; INTEGRATION NEEDED (the one-line wiring of `productRenewalSweep()` into the worker loop + suggested interval); risks.

content.text:
Done. Both files created, nothing else touched.

## Files created
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/product-billing.ts` — pure, dependency-free policy/pricing module (no `db`, no I/O), unit-testable. Exports `renewalDecision`, `nextExpiry`, `graceEndsAt`/`isPastGrace`, `reclaimAt`, `dedupeSince`, `isDueForRenewal`/`isRenewingSoon`, `needsUpcomingWarning`, `canAfford`, `emailRenewalCents`/`emailRenewalMonths`, `volumeRenewalCents`, `money`/`ymd`, plus the constants.
- `/opt/nxeon/worker/product-renewals.ts` — exports `productRenewalSweep(): Promise<void>`.

Verified with `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean — the only errors are pre-existing `TS5097` in `test/*.test.ts`) and a runtime sanity run of every pure helper.

## Policy
Shared timeline, mirroring `worker/billing.ts`: `PRODUCT_GRACE_DAYS = NXEON_GRACE_DAYS ?? 3` (same env var, so all products on an account expire on one schedule), warn window `NXEON_PRODUCT_WARN_DAYS ?? 3`, notification dedupe 4 days.

**Business email** (`EmailSubscription`, status `ACTIVE`, `expiresAt < now`)
- T-3d: if `!autoRenew || balance < plan.priceCents` → one "renews soon — action needed" notice per dedupe window.
- T+0, `autoRenew` and funds present → charge `emailPlan.priceCents`, extend by `emailPlan.termMonths`, wallet txn, `auditLog action:"billing.renewed"`, success notification.
- T+0..T+3d unpaid → subscription keeps delivering; one "renewal failed — top up" notice naming the suspend date.
- T+3d → `status = "SUSPENDED"`, `billing.suspended_unpaid` audit, notification. **Mailboxes are never deleted** and nothing is cancelled.

**Volumes** (`Volume`, status in `PENDING|ATTACHED|DETACHED`; `DELETING` excluded). No `autoRenew` column, so treated as always-on.
- T-3d insufficient balance → "renews soon" notice.
- T+0 funded → charge `priceCents`, extend 1 month (`VOLUME_TERM_MONTHS`), audit `billing.renewed`, notify.
- T+0..T+3d → stays attached and usable; one "renewal failed" notice.
- T+3d → if `ATTACHED`: flip to `DETACHED` **and** enqueue `VOLUME_DETACH` (one transaction, so it can never be marked detached without the job) + `billing.volume_detached_unpaid` audit + a notification stating explicitly that nothing was deleted and the data re-attaches as-is on payment. If already `PENDING`/`DETACHED`: no state change, just a deduped "unpaid" reminder. **No `VOLUME_DELETE` is ever enqueued** — the reclaim date (`grace + NXEON_TERMINATE_DAYS`) appears only as wording so the customer knows a staff removal is possible; no code acts on it.

Before flipping an `ATTACHED` volume it checks the server's `QUEUED|RUNNING` job count and defers to the next sweep if busy, honoring the same one-in-flight-job guard `lib/actions-volumes.ts` and `worker/billing.ts` use.

## No-double-charge guarantee
Beyond "the due query only selects `expiresAt < now`", each charge is a **compare-and-swap inside one interactive transaction**:

```ts
const advanced = await tx.emailSubscription.updateMany({
  where: { id: sub.id, status: "ACTIVE", expiresAt: sub.expiresAt },  // old expiry
  data:  { expiresAt: newExpiry },
});
if (advanced.count === 0) throw new AlreadyHandledError(...);
await debitWallet(tx, sub.userId, priceCents);   // only reached by the winner
```

The row only matches while it still carries the exact expiry the decision was based on, so a repeat pass or a second worker matches zero rows, throws, and rolls back the whole transaction — wallet debit, txn row and audit included. `debitWallet` (`lib/wallet.ts`) adds its own conditional `balanceCents >= cents` guard, so a concurrent spend can't drive the balance negative; that case rolls back the expiry bump too and simply retries next sweep. `nextExpiry` bases off `max(expiresAt, now)`, so a long-expired item is brought one term forward from today with a **single** charge instead of being back-billed per missed period. The enforcement paths use the same CAS (`status: "ACTIVE"` → `SUSPENDED`, `status: "ATTACHED"` → `DETACHED`), so suspend/detach and their notifications also fire exactly once. Charges with `priceCents <= 0` skip the wallet entirely.

Defensiveness: four independently try/caught phases, and every row inside each phase runs through a `step()` wrapper — one poisoned row logs and is skipped, never aborting the sweep. Notifications are best-effort and are sent *after* the transaction commits, so a notify failure can never roll back a successful charge.

## Risks
- **Not wired up yet** — zero revenue is collected until the two lines above land in `worker/index.ts`.
- **Backlog on first run.** Every email subscription and volume ordered more than one term ago is already past due, so the first sweep will charge them all at once and detach/suspend anything whose owner is more than `GRACE_DAYS` overdue with an empty wallet. Consider a one-off `expiresAt` bump (or temporarily raising `NXEON_GRACE_DAYS`) before enabling, to give customers a warning window.
- **Notification dedupe keys off the entity label in the title** (same technique as `billing.ts`). Domain names are effectively unique per user, but `Volume.name` is not unique — two same-named volumes for one user would share a dedupe key and one duplicate warning could be suppressed. Enforcement itself is never gated by dedupe, so billing correctness is unaffected.
- **Detach race:** between the status flip to `DETACHED` and the `VOLUME_DETACH` job running, `attachVolume` in `lib/actions-volumes.ts` would consider the volume attachable. Window is seconds and the worst case is a re-attach immediately followed by the queued detach.
- **`EmailSubscription` has no un-suspend path yet.** The sweep sets `SUSPENDED` and stops looking at the row (the due query filters `status: "ACTIVE"`), so a paying customer needs a UI/action to reactivate — that lives in `lib/actions-email-hosting.ts`, which is not mine. Worth flagging as a follow-up so suspended subscriptions aren't stranded.
- Mailbox provisioning is still a stub, so suspension currently has no external mail-provider effect beyond the DB flag; once a provider lands, `suspendEmail` should also pause delivery there.
